changelog:
- Initial release of the agent-team-orchestration skill.
- Adds team orchestration playbook for multi-agent workflows, roles, handoffs, and reviews.
- New metadata file (_meta.json) introduced.
- Old documentation file (skill-card.md) removed.
summary: Orchestrate multi-agent teams with defined roles, task lifecycles, handoff protocols, and review workflows. Use when: (1) Setting up a team of 2+ agents with different specializations, (2) Defining task routing and lifecycle (inbox → spec → build → review → done), (3) Creating handoff protocols between agents, (4) Establishing review and quality gates, (5) Managing async communication and artifact sharing between agents.
